summary: ArcBot can now keep several OpenAI and Claude accounts and switch between them from Settings.
details: The new Account section shows the account each provider uses, with its email or sign-in state; its menu switches accounts, signs in or out, and removes added accounts.
Add Account… takes a name and opens the sign-in window; each added account keeps its own sign-in, separate from your main one.
ArcBot notices when sign-in finishes, and switching applies to the next request.
